topic.title: PrettyTable Demo
topic.description: Uses the PrettyTable library to display structured tabular data with a Pokémon example. Introduces third-party library usage and table formatting.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Installing PrettyTable via pip, adding columns of data, setting alignment, and printing a formatted table to the console.
learningNotes.challenges: None — library is straightforward. Focus is on understanding library documentation.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Display data loaded from a CSV file or an API response in a PrettyTable.
